model: Test model with several levels. Replace every angle-bracket placeholder with a real name from this model before running.
note: Ten sheet-creation prompts, run once before and once after the runnable-playbooks change. Each step is one drafter message. Reopen the model without saving before every step. 'expect' is what to check in Revit afterwards.

steps.text: Create a sheet for every level using the <Title Block> title block.
steps.expect: One sheet per level in the model, numbered A-101, A-102 and so on in level order. Each sheet holds the floor plan of its level, placed once, near the centre. Nothing else in the model changed.

steps.text: Make sheets for <Level A> and <Level B>, floor plans, title block <Title Block>.
steps.expect: Exactly two new sheets, numbered A-101 and A-102. One has the floor plan of <Level A>, the other of <Level B>, each placed once. No sheet for any other level. Nothing else changed.

steps.text: I need ceiling plan sheets for <Level A> and <Level B> with the <Title Block> title block.
steps.expect: Two new sheets, each holding the ceiling plan (not the floor plan) of its level, placed once. Floor plans are not placed on any new sheet. Nothing else changed.

steps.text: Create floor plan sheets for all levels with title block <Title Block>. Number them S-201, S-202 and so on.
steps.expect: One sheet per level, numbered S-201, S-202, S-203 and so on in level order. No sheet starts with A-. Each floor plan placed once. Nothing else changed.

steps.text: Tolong buat sheet untuk semua level, floor plan, guna title block <Title Block>.
steps.expect: One sheet per level, each using the <Title Block> title block (check in sheet properties). Each floor plan placed once. Numbers A-101 onwards. Nothing else changed.

steps.text: Buat sheet untuk <Level A> dengan <Level B> ye.
steps.expect: The title block is required and was not given, so Copilot asks one question about which title block to use, and no sheet exists yet. After you answer with <Title Block>, two sheets are made, each with that title block and its level's floor plan placed once. It must not pick a title block by itself without saying so.

steps.area: Sheets: level with two plans of the type (Malay)
steps.text: Buat sheet untuk <Level With Two Plans>, floor plan, title block <Title Block>. Guna plan <Plan Name> ye.
steps.expect: One new sheet for <Level With Two Plans> holding only the plan <Plan Name>, placed once. The other plan of that level is not placed. Nothing else changed. If the plan name was left out, the level must be reported as skipped, not guessed.

steps.text: Buat sheet floor plan untuk <Level A> dan <Level B>, title block <Title Block>, nombor mula A-101.
steps.expect: Before running, make sure a sheet numbered A-101 already exists in the model. Two new sheets are made with the next free numbers (for example A-102 and A-103), none duplicating an existing number. The existing sheet is unchanged. Each plan placed once.

steps.area: Sheets: no levels said, many levels in model (Malay)
steps.text: Boleh buat sheet untuk floor plan? Title block <Title Block>.
steps.expect: Copilot asks one question: which levels. No sheet exists yet. After you answer 'semua level', one sheet per level is made, each with the floor plan placed once. Count the answer in the words typed.

steps.area: Sheets: plan type the model does not have (Malay)
steps.text: Buat sheet ceiling plan untuk <Level Without Ceiling Plan>, title block <Title Block>.
steps.expect: Use a level that has no ceiling plan. No sheet is created. The result says that level has no ceiling plan and was skipped. Nothing in the model changed, and no empty sheet was left behind.
